title_en: Beijing Gongda Real Estate Co., Ltd. v. Beijing Xianghe Sanxia Real Estate Development Company — dispute over a real estate development contract
ruling_gist_en: The legal representative of a company represents the company in civil activities in accordance with law. Where the legal representative changes, a change registration shall be completed with the administrative department for industry and commerce. If the legal representative of a company has been decided by the superior unit to cease office at the time of signing a contract with an external party, but the change registration has not been completed, and the company claims that the contract is invalid on this ground, the people's court shall not support such claim.
keywords_en: Civil; Real estate development contract dispute; Retrial; Supreme People's Court; Beijing; Legal person; General Principles of Civil Law; Effect of registration of change of legal representative; Determination of unauthorized agency; Validity of contract; Reversal of judgment; Transfer of real estate development project; Change of legal representative; Unauthorized agency; Good faith; Contract dispute; Application for retrial; Development company real estate development contract dispute
full_text_en:
Beijing Gongda Real Estate Co., Ltd. v. Beijing Xianghe Sanxia Real Estate Development Company — dispute over real estate development contract

Ruling Summary

The legal representative of a company shall, in accordance with the law, represent the company in conducting civil activities externally. Where there is a change of legal representative, the change of registration shall be completed with the administrative department for industry and commerce. Where the legal representative of a company has been decided by the superior unit to cease his or her position at the time of signing a contract externally, but the change of registration has not been completed, and the company claims the contract is invalid on such basis, the People's Court shall not support the claim.

Civil Judgment of the Supreme People's Court

Civil Retrial No. 76 (2009)

Petitioner for Retrial (Plaintiff at First Instance, Appellant at Second Instance): Beijing Gongda Real Estate Co., Ltd., domiciled at Room 220, Building 31, Muxidi Nanli, Xicheng District, Beijing.

Legal representative: Yu Xiaodong, Chairman of the Board of the company.

Respondent (Defendant at First Instance, Appellee at Second Instance): Beijing Xianghe Sanxia Real Estate Development Company, domiciled at Room 521, No. 33, Funei Chengfang Street, Xicheng District, Beijing.

Person in charge: Wang Mingyou, person in charge of the company.

Agent ad litem: Ling Yun, lawyer of Beijing Shouxin Law Firm.

Agent ad litem: Wang Min, lawyer of Beijing Shouxin Law Firm.

The Petitioner for Retrial, Beijing Gongda Real Estate Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Gongda Company), dissatisfied with the Civil Judgment (1997) Gao Min Zhong Zi No. 114 rendered by the Beijing High People's Court in the dispute over a real estate development contract with the Respondent, Beijing Xianghe Sanxia Real Estate Development Company (hereinafter referred to as Sanxia Company), filed a petition for retrial with this Court. This Court rendered a Civil Ruling (2007) Min Yi Jian Zi No. 329-1 on April 7, 2008, granting the retrial of this case. This Court formed a collegial panel according to law and held a hearing in this case on November 16, 2009. Yu Xiaodong, legal representative of Gongda Company, and Ling Yun and Wang Min, agents ad litem of Sanxia Company, appeared before the court for the proceedings. On November 23, 2009, this Court questioned Yu Xiaodong and Wang Min regarding the relevant facts of the case. This case is now concluded.

On March 12, 1996, the Plaintiff at First Instance, Gongda Company, filed a lawsuit with the Beijing No. 1 Intermediate People's Court, alleging: On April 13, 1995, Gongda Company entered into a transfer contract with Sanxia Company (formerly known as Beijing Yannan Sanxia Real Estate Development Company) regarding the real estate development project at No. 26 Gexinli, Chongwen District, Beijing (hereinafter referred to as the Gexinli Project), whereby Sanxia Company transferred all development rights of the Gexinli Project to Gongda Company. However, after Sanxia Company changed its name, it not only failed to perform the contract but also denied the validity of the contract signed between the two parties. Therefore, Gongda Company requested that Sanxia Company perform the contract and compensate for economic losses of RMB 2.5 million. Sanxia Company argued: The transfer contract for the Gexinli Project signed by Liu Yuzhang, the former legal representative of Sanxia Company's predecessor Beijing Yannan Sanxia Real Estate Development Company, with Gongda Company was executed after Liu Yuzhang had been removed from his position and could not represent the company; the contract was invalid. Thus, Sanxia Company disagreed with Gongda Company's claims.

The Beijing No. 1 Intermediate People's Court found at first instance: Beijing Yannan Sanxia Real Estate Development Company was established with the approval of China Sanxia Economic Development Corporation and registered with the Daxing County Administrative Bureau for Industry and Commerce on March 19, 1993, with Liu Yuzhang as its legal representative. On April 12, 1994, Beijing Kitchen Equipment Group Corporation (hereinafter referred to as Beichu Group) (Party A) and Sanxia Company (Party B) signed the "Contract for the Paid Transfer of the Former Site of Beijing Kitchen Equipment Factory," stipulating that Party A would transfer to Party B the property rights of the premises located at No. 26 Gexinli, Yongwai Street, Chongwen District, Beijing, with a total area of approximately 7,400 square meters and a building area of 5,000 square meters; Party B would pay Party A a transfer fee of RMB 25 million. Subsequently, Lv Jinghui, manager of the business department under Sanxia Company, delivered RMB 15 million to Beichu Group. On November 14, 1994, Sanxia Company paid an additional RMB 2 million to Beichu Group. On June 10, 1994, the Beijing Municipal Construction Commission, by Document (94) Jing Jian Kai Zi No. 294, approved Sanxia Real Estate Development Company to establish Beijing Yannan Sanxia Real Estate Development Company in Beijing, with its business scope covering the development and construction of two projects: the comprehensive building at Mingguang Village, Xueyuan South Road, Haidian District, and the renovation of residential buildings at No. 26 Yard, Gexinli, Yongwai, Chongwen District, and the operation and sale of commercial housing. On July 10 of the same year, the business department of Sanxia Company (Party A) and Beijing Huatai Real Estate Operation and Development Company (hereinafter referred to as Huatai Company) (Party B) signed an agreement for the cooperative development of the Gexinli Project, under which Party B was to provide RMB 38 million as land purchase funds. Thereafter, Huatai Company paid part of the funds to Sanxia Company. On July 31, 1994, Sanxia Company and Gongda Company signed an agreement for the cooperative development of the No. 26 Gexinli yard, stipulating that the two parties would jointly raise funds and share profits in proportion to their investments. On August 3 of the same year, the Real Estate Operation and Development Department of China Sanxia Economic Development Corporation and Sanxia Real Estate Development Company jointly issued a decision to terminate Liu Yuzhang's position as manager of Sanxia Company. Liu Yuzhang received the decision on August 9 of the same year. On September 19, 1994, the Beijing Municipal Planning Commission and the Beijing Municipal Construction Commission, by Document Jing Ji Ji Zi (1994) No. 1165, approved Sanxia Company to develop and construct the Gexinli Residential Area. In 1994, the Beijing Municipal Construction Commission, by Document (94) Jing Jian Kai Zi No. 541, approved the establishment of Gongda Company, with its business scope being the joint development of the Gexinli Project with Huatai Company. In February 1995, Huatai Company filed a lawsuit with the court of first instance on the grounds that Sanxia Company had refused to perform the agreement signed by the two parties on July 14, 1994, requesting that Sanxia Company continue to perform the contract. The court of first instance, by Civil Judgment (1995) Zhong Jing Chu Zi No. 192, dated July 26, 1995, ruled that the two parties should continue to cooperatively develop the Gexinli Project; neither party appealed. On February 28, 1995, Sanxia Real Estate Development Company applied to the Daxing County Administration for Industry and Commerce to change the legal representative of the enterprise from Liu Yuzhang to Zhang Shengli. On April 13, 15, and 17, 1995, Liu Yuzhang, holding the official seal of Sanxia Company and acting as the legal representative, signed the transfer agreement and supplementary agreements for the Gexinli Project with Gongda Company, stipulating that Sanxia Company would transfer the entire project to Gongda Company, with Gongda Company fully responsible for completing the project and assuming all claims and debts. On April 18 of the same month, Sanxia Company and Gongda Company jointly submitted a report on the Gexinli Project to the Beijing Municipal Construction Commission and the Beijing Municipal Planning Commission. The report stated that the two parties had agreed that, after the formal approval documents from the "Four Commissions" of the city were issued, they would submit for the record to the Construction Commission and the Planning Commission. On April 22, 1995, the Daxing County Administration for Industry and Commerce changed the legal representative of Sanxia Company from Liu Yuzhang to Zhang Shengli. On June 8 of the same year, the Beijing Municipal Economic Commission, the Beijing Municipal Planning Commission, the Beijing Municipal Urban and Rural Planning Commission, and the Beijing Municipal Municipal Management Commission, by Document (95) Jing An Zi No. 278, approved the paid transfer of the use right of the original factory site of Beichu Group at No. 26 Gexinli to Sanxia Company. On June 29, Beijing Yannan Sanxia Real Estate Development Company changed its name to Sanxia Company through the Xicheng District Administration for Industry and Commerce. During the proceedings, Gongda Company claimed that it had invested RMB 17 million in the Gexinli Project but failed to provide evidence.

The court of first instance held that civil activities should follow the principles of voluntariness, fairness, equivalence and mutual benefit, and good faith. Where Sanxia Company entered into a transfer agreement with Gongda Company before it had formally obtained the development rights for the Gexinli Project, although the development rights of Sanxia Company were subsequently approved by the relevant authorities, because Liu Yuzhang, the former legal representative of Sanxia Company, knowing that he had been removed from his position, still signed the transfer agreement for the Gexinli Project with Gongda Company in the capacity of the company's legal representative, this constituted an act without authority. Moreover, at the time when Huatai Company and Sanxia Company were in litigation in court to resolve their dispute over the performance of the cooperation agreement, Liu Yuzhang concealed the truth from the court of first instance and failed to consult the cooperating party Huatai Company, thereby infringing upon the interests of others. Therefore, the agreement was invalid. Gongda Company's request for Sanxia Company to continue performance and compensate for losses based on the invalid agreement lacked legal basis and was not supported. Gongda Company's claim that it had invested RMB 17 million in the project was not credible as it failed to provide corresponding evidence. In accordance with Articles 4, 58, and paragraph 1 of Article 66 of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China, the Beijing No. 1 Intermediate People's Court rendered Civil Judgment (1996) Yi Zhong Min Chu Zi No. 733 on April 4, 1997, dismissing Gongda Company's claims.

Gongda Company, dissatisfied with the judgment of first instance, appealed to the Beijing High People's Court, alleging: At the time the two parties signed the project transfer agreement, Liu Yuzhang was the legal representative of Sanxia Company. The court of first instance erroneously characterized Liu Yuzhang's status as legal representative as an agent, confusing basic facts and legal relations. After Gongda Company legally and in good faith received the project under the agreement, it actively carried out project development in accordance with state regulations and received recognition from various competent authorities. Internal disputes of Sanxia Company should not harm the legitimate rights and interests of the party Gongda Company. Sanxia Company materially breached the contract and should compensate for losses according to law. Sanxia Company argued in answer: When Liu Yuzhang signed the project transfer contract with Gongda Company, he had been removed from his position and no longer had the identity of the company's legal representative and could not sign contracts on behalf of the company. Therefore, Sanxia Company disagreed with Gongda Company's claims.

The Beijing High People's Court found at second instance that the facts found by the court of first instance were consistent.

The Beijing High People's Court held at second instance: Liu Yuzhang concealed from Gongda Company the fact that Sanxia Company and Huatai Company had already signed an agreement for the cooperative development of the Gexinli Project, that he himself had been removed from the position of legal representative of Sanxia Company, and that Huatai Company and Sanxia Company were in the midst of litigation in court over the performance of their cooperation agreement. He nevertheless signed the transfer agreement for the Gexinli Project with Gongda Company, violating the principle of good faith and constituting fraudulent conduct. Moreover, the Beijing No. 1 Intermediate People's Court had already ruled that Huatai Company and Sanxia Company should cooperatively develop the Gexinli Project. Therefore, the agreement signed between Sanxia Company and Gongda Company was invalid. Liu Yuzhang should bear liability for rendering the agreement invalid. Gongda Company's claims were not supported. The Beijing High People's Court rendered Civil Judgment (1997) Gao Min Zhong Zi No. 114 on September 13, 1997, dismissing the appeal and affirming the original judgment.

Gongda Company filed a petition for retrial, alleging: The agreement between Gongda Company and Sanxia Company was signed on April 13, 1995, while Sanxia Company's change of legal representative from Liu Yuzhang to Zhang Shengli occurred on April 22, 1995. According to national regulations on industrial and commercial administration, Sanxia Company should bear responsibility for the agreement signed with Gongda Company. The original court's judgment based on Sanxia Company's internal decision lacks legal basis. The agreements signed between Huatai Company and Sanxia Company were all executed by subordinate departments of the two companies, neither bearing the official seals of the legal persons nor signatures of the legal representatives, and neither company had registered branches with the industrial and commercial bureau. Therefore, those agreements were invalid. Up to now, over ten years, Huatai Company has not performed the contract based on the court's judgment, nor has it obtained legal procedures or made any investment. Gongda Company was established with the approval of the Beijing Municipal Construction Commission by Document (94) Jing Jian Kai Zi No. 541 in October 1994, authorizing it to be responsible for the development and construction of the Gexinli Residential Area. On April 18, 1995, Sanxia Company and Gongda Company jointly reported to the Beijing Municipal Construction Commission and the Beijing Municipal Planning Commission, requesting the transfer of the Gexinli Project to Gongda Company. On January 10, 1996, the Development Office of the Beijing Municipal Construction Commission held a coordination meeting, clarifying that although Sanxia Company had changed its legal representative, the transfer of the Gexinli Project to Gongda Company was valid. On April 5, 1996, the Beijing Municipal Planning Commission and the Beijing Municipal Construction Commission jointly issued a document approving that the Gexinli Project be developed and constructed by Gongda Company. On January 17, 1997, the Beijing Municipal Bureau of Housing and Land Administration signed the "Beijing State-owned Land Use Right Grant Contract" with Gongda Company. On June 9, 1997, the Beijing Municipal Planning Bureau issued a building project planning permit to Gongda Company. On June 23, 1997, the Beijing Municipal Construction Commission issued a building project commencement permit to Gongda Company. Undoubtedly, Gongda Company had obtained all lawful and valid procedures for the Gexinli Project. Subsequently, Beijing Dalong Construction Group entered the site and commenced construction. However, on September 13, 1997, the Beijing High People's Court, by Civil Judgment (1997) Gao Min Zhong Zi No. 114, ruled that the transfer agreement between Sanxia Company and Gongda Company was invalid. Consequently, on March 15, 1999, the Beijing Municipal Construction Commission and the Beijing Municipal Planning Commission jointly issued a document revoking the Gexinli development project and specifying that the debts, claims, and economic disputes arising from this project would be executed in accordance with the court's judgment. On October 16, 2000, the Beijing No. 2 Intermediate People's Court issued a civil mediation document in the case of Beijing Xinglu Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Xinglu Company) v. Gongda Company regarding a dispute over a house purchase and sales contract, and on March 2, 2001, sealed up the land for the Gexinli Project under Gongda Company's name. On April 16, 2001, Xinglu Company and Gongda Company signed a settlement agreement for enforcement. On April 17, 2001, the Beijing No. 2 Intermediate People's Court issued an assistance enforcement notice to the Beijing Municipal Bureau of Land and Resources and Housing Administration. On April 12, 2002, the land use right was transferred to Xinglu Company. However, due to the effective Civil Judgment (1997) Gao Min Zhong Zi No. 114 of the Beijing High People's Court, the Beijing No. 2 Intermediate People's Court, by Civil Ruling dated April 29, 2007, held that the transfer of the land use right from Gongda Company to Xinglu Company was improper and should be revoked, restoring the status quo before enforcement. Thus, from 1995 to 2007, over 12 years, all economic activities of Gongda Company were negated, and all administrative acts of the competent government departments in Beijing were overturned, rendering an investment of nearly RMB 50 million in the Gexinli Project futile. For these reasons, Gongda Company requested the Supreme People's Court to revoke Civil Judgment (1997) Gao Min Zhong Zi No. 114 of the Beijing High People's Court.

Sanxia Company argued in answer: The superior unit of Sanxia Company had removed Liu Yuzhang from his position on August 3, 1994, nullifying his status as legal representative. Liu Yuzhang signed the contract with Gongda Company without Sanxia Company's knowledge. This contract was not performed, and the certificate of land use right was not issued under Gongda Company's name. This case does not apply to apparent agency. The project in this case was specifically signed between Sanxia Company and Beichu Group. Liu Yuzhang, without the consent of Beichu Group, transferred the contractual rights and obligations to Gongda Company, rendering the contract invalid.

This Court found upon retrial: 1. On January 10, 1996, the Beijing Municipal Comprehensive Development Office for Urban Development and Construction convened a meeting with Sanxia Company and Gongda Company to study the development and construction of the Gexinli Project. Zhang Shengli, the then legal representative of Sanxia Company, and Yu Xiaodong, the legal representative of Gongda Company, attended the meeting, and a meeting minutes were issued. The meeting minutes confirmed that the agreement, signed on April 13, 1995, between Sanxia Company and Gongda Company transferring the project to Gongda Company was valid. 2. On April 5, 1996, the Beijing Municipal Planning Commission and the Beijing Municipal Construction Commission approved Gongda Company to develop and construct the Gexinli Project. 3. Gongda Company stated that after signing the contract with Sanxia Company, it proceeded with development and entered into a house purchase contract with Xinglu Company. Later, due to the failure to complete the houses and deliver them, a lawsuit arose between the parties. On October 16, 2000, the Beijing No. 2 Intermediate People's Court issued a civil mediation document in the case of Xinglu Company v. Gongda Company regarding a dispute over a house purchase and sales contract, and on March 2, 2001, sealed up the land for the Gexinli Project under Gongda Company's name. On April 16, 2001, Xinglu Company and Gongda Company signed a settlement agreement for enforcement. On April 17, 2001, the Beijing No. 2 Intermediate People's Court issued an assistance enforcement notice to the Beijing Municipal Bureau of Land and Resources and Housing Administration. On April 12, 2002, the land use right was transferred to Xinglu Company. Due to the entry into force of Civil Judgment (1997) Gao Min Zhong Zi No. 114 of the Beijing High People's Court, the Beijing No. 2 Intermediate People's Court, by Civil Ruling on April 29, 2007, held that the transfer of the land use right from Gongda Company to Xinglu Company was improper and should be revoked, restoring the status quo before enforcement. Currently, the land use right certificate is still under Xinglu Company's name. 4. Huatai Company and Sanxia Company had previously litigated before the former Beijing Intermediate People's Court regarding the cooperative development of the Gexinli Project. That court rendered a first-instance judgment on July 26, 1995, ordering the two parties to perform the cooperative project, and the judgment became effective. Subsequently, relevant government departments in Beijing issued documents identifying Gongda Company as the project development entity, and Huatai Company was not the development entity.

Other facts found by this Court upon retrial are consistent with those found by the original courts.

This Court held upon retrial: Based on the reasons for the petition for retrial and the answer, the focus of dispute in this case is whether the project transfer contract signed between Gongda Company and Sanxia Company is valid.

On April 13, 1995, Liu Yuzhang, acting as the legal representative of Sanxia Company, signed the transfer agreement for the Gexinli Project with Gongda Company. The agreement bore the official seal of Sanxia Company and the signature of Liu Yuzhang. At that time, although Liu Yuzhang had been removed from his position by the superior unit of Sanxia Company, the change of Sanxia Company's legal representative from Liu Yuzhang to Zhang Shengli was not registered with the industrial and commercial administration until April 22, 1995. That is, at the time Liu Yuzhang signed the project transfer agreement with Gongda Company, Liu Yuzhang was still listed as the legal representative of Sanxia Company in the industrial and commercial registration. Liu Yuzhang's signing of the agreement in the capacity of legal representative satisfied the formal requirements for an enterprise legal person to conduct civil activities externally. Moreover, the agreement also bore the official seal of Sanxia Company. Therefore, the project transfer agreement signed by the two parties should be deemed to have been lawfully established and effective. Although Liu Yuzhang had been decided by his superior unit to cease his position at the time of signing the agreement, that decision was an internal work adjustment of Sanxia Company. Liu Yuzhang's identity in representing Sanxia Company in external civil activities should still be based on the public information in the industrial and commercial registration. The validity of his external representative acts cannot be denied based on the change of position of the company's internal staff. Furthermore, on January 10, 1996, the Beijing Municipal Comprehensive Development Office for Urban Development and Construction convened a meeting with Sanxia Company and Gongda Company to study the development and construction of the Gexinli Project. Zhang Shengli, the then legal representative of Sanxia Company, attended the meeting. This fact indicates that Sanxia Company also recognized the validity of the project transfer agreement signed between Sanxia Company and Gongda Company. The original court's determination that Liu Yuzhang's signing of the agreement with Gongda Company constituted an act without authority on the ground of internal personnel adjustment of Sanxia Company was an error in fact finding and should be corrected.

On April 12, 1994, Beichu Group and Sanxia Company signed the "Contract for the Paid Transfer of the Former Site of Beijing Kitchen Equipment Factory." The Beijing Municipal Construction Committee, by Document No. (94) Jing Jian Kai Zi No. 294, approved Sanxia Company's development and operation of the Gexinli Project. Under these circumstances, Sanxia Company transferred the development rights it had obtained for the Gexinli Project to Gongda Company, which would carry out the construction and development. On October 11, 1994, the Beijing Municipal Construction Committee, by Document No. (94) Jing Jian Kai Zi No. 541, approved the establishment of Gongda Company to jointly develop the Gexinli Project with Huatai Company. Subsequently, the Beijing Municipal Housing and Land Administration Bureau signed the "State-owned Land Use Right Grant Contract for Beijing" with Gongda Company, the Beijing Municipal Planning Bureau issued a construction project planning permit to Gongda Company, and the Beijing Municipal Construction Committee issued a construction project commencement certificate to Gongda Company. The above facts show that Gongda Company obtained the development and operation rights for the Gexinli Project based on its project transfer agreement with Sanxia Company, and this was recognized by the competent government authorities. Sanxia Company's act of signing a project transfer agreement with Huatai Company and then signing a similar agreement with Gongda Company constituted a breach of contract and could not result in the legal consequence of invalidating the agreement in dispute in this case. The court of first instance's determination that the project transfer agreement signed between Gongda Company and Sanxia Company was invalid lacked legal basis and should be corrected.

Although Gongda Company claimed in the original trial that Sanxia Company should compensate it for contractual breach damages of RMB 2.5 million, it did not provide corresponding evidence. The court of first instance's refusal to support this claim was not improper. Gongda Company's petition claims that the first-instance judgment's invalidation of the contract led to the revocation of its development project by relevant authorities, causing losses, and its request for this Court to rule on the ownership of the project in question, are not within the scope of this case and should be pursued by Gongda Company through other channels with the relevant authorities.

In summary, pursuant to Article 186, paragraph 1, and Article 153, paragraph 1, subparagraphs (2) and (3) of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the judgment is as follows:

1. Revoke the Civil Judgment (1996) Yi Zhong Min Chu Zi No. 733 of the Beijing No. 1 Intermediate People's Court and the Civil Judgment (1997) Gao Min Zhong Zi No. 114 of the Beijing High People's Court;

2. The "Development Project Transfer Agreement" signed by Beijing Gongda Real Estate Co., Ltd. and Beijing Xianghe Sanxia Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. is valid;

3. Dismiss all other claims of Beijing Gongda Real Estate Co., Ltd.

Court acceptance fee for the first instance: RMB 107,510, of which Beijing Gongda Real Estate Co., Ltd. shall bear RMB 13,976 and Beijing Xianghe Sanxia Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. shall bear RMB 93,534; Court acceptance fee for the second instance: RMB 107,510, of which Beijing Gongda Real Estate Co., Ltd. shall bear RMB 13,976 and Beijing Xianghe Sanxia Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. shall bear RMB 93,534.

This judgment is final.

Presiding Judge: Yang Yongqing

Judge: Li Mingyi

Acting Judge: Yao Baohua

December 22, 2009

Clerk: Liu Ning
